title: M11 H3 model protocol contracts 1.0.0
description: Structural interchange schema. scripts/m11_contract.py additionally enforces source/version identity, exact derived values, role/timeline relationships, original-request recompilation and atomic acceptance. Schema validation alone is not acceptance.
x-adapter-limits: Only the pinned official English grammar is implemented.
Semantic English fragments and first vocal event times are explicitly supplied, not inferred.
Only object JSON Pointer paths or single top-level keys are supported; array-index paths and connected workflow graph evaluation are not implemented.
Runtime media values are locator strings, serialized into an explicit channel/order/label object list.
No network, inference, source authenticity checks, media loading or writes are performed.
